name: Mistakes
description: One row per mistake-book entry (grouped by stable id so repeated review updates the same card instead of duplicating it) — root cause, misconception, fix strategy, similar practice prompt, and parent note. Written by scripts/record_homework.mjs alongside the question it came from

agentPrompts.label: Add or update a mistake-book entry
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-homework-coach` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then turn the wrong answer I describe into a mistake-book card — root cause, misconception, fix strategy, a similar practice prompt, and the next review date. Reuse the same mistake id if this is the same recurring mistake instead of creating a duplicate card, and use supportive language, never words like "careless" or "lazy".

agentPrompts.label: What mistakes are due for review?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-homework-coach` skill in this folder, then list the mistake-book entries due for review today or soon, grouped by topic, with each one's root cause and fix strategy.
